summary: Iteration 25 — Backend-only tests for GAP 1/2/3 in order cancel & reopen. Added /app/backend/tests/test_cancel_reopen_iter25.py with 11 test cases covering (a) manual admin cancel side-effects (restock + coupon decrement + affiliate reversal only if was_paid), (b) audit metadata (cancelled_at, cancelled_reason='admin_manual', prev_payment_status), (c) fulfillment-status transition triggers same effects, (d) POST /admin/orders/{id}/reopen — 400 non-cancelled, 409 with rollback on insufficient stock, happy path (stock re-decrement + coupon restore + audit note + reopened_at), reopen with mark_paid=True → 'paid', (e) idempotence over cancel→reopen→cancel→cancel, (f) auto-cancel regression (cancel_stale_unpaid_orders uses _cancel_order_side_effects with reverse_affiliate=False), (g) late-payment detection via _process_interac_deposit_emails with monkey-patched Graph helpers (idempotent — single warning note). 11/11 pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L.7600 _decrement_coupon_usage: correctly lowercases order.email before matching used_by.email — assumes checkout stored emails already lowercased. Confirmed by fixture: seeded uppercase email → per-email counter did NOT decrement (test caught this initially). Not a bug in prod because checkout/registration normalise. Consider defensive .lower() on write everywhere to avoid such drift.

server.py L.4247 admin_reopen_order: stock re-decrement is truly atomic (single findAndModify per line via $elemMatch/$gte), and rollback loop correctly walks 'reserved' if a later line fails. Coupon restore respects usage_limit. Good.

server.py L.6900 late-payment branch in _process_interac_deposit_emails: idempotent via not late.get('late_payment_flagged') guard; adds exactly one system note per cancelled order even if multiple emails carry the same ref. Verified with two calls.

server.py L.7625 _cancel_order_side_effects: swallows affiliate_on_order_reversed exceptions with logging.warning — correctly prevents the cancel path from failing if the affiliate module raises. Verified compile path; no runtime exception seen in tests.
server.py L.4344 reopen sets fulfillment_status='processing' when has_preorder is False (else keeps existing). Reasonable — a re-opened preorder retains its preorder queue slot.
Minor nit — reopen response never returns the audit note 'Order reopened by <admin>' because the $push happens BEFORE the final find_one; test verified it's present in DB. Fine.
seed_data_creation: All test data is prefixed with TEST_iter25_ and cleaned up via module-scoped autouse fixture (orders/products/coupons/affiliate_referrals). No production docs touched. Test uses http://localhost:8001 directly (per request) and imports server.py to call cancel_stale_unpaid_orders() and _process_interac_deposit_emails() directly with monkey-patched Graph helpers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run tests: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_cancel_reopen_iter25.py -v -n 0 --tb=short . Order numbers MUST match regex FN-\d{6}-[0-9A-F]{6} for _extract_interac_refs to pick them up. Customer emails on seeded coupons.used_by MUST be lowercase to match _decrement_coupon_usage which lowercases before matching. cancel_stale_unpaid_orders and _process_interac_deposit_emails are called directly (not via HTTP) since they run in a background watchdog.
rca of the issue: N/A — all three gaps behave as specified in the review request. Manual admin cancel now decrements coupons and reverses affiliate commissions (only when order was paid) with proper audit metadata; a new /reopen endpoint atomically re-decrements stock (with full rollback on failure) and restores prev_payment_status or transitions to paid; and _process_interac_deposit_emails correctly flags late payments on cancelled orders with an idempotent system note.
